#{sid}

SELECT x.biz_id AS bizId, SUM(c.tonnage) AS tonnage, SUM(c.volume) AS volume, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT cs.ship_idcs.company_id AS biz_id, cs.cargo_id FROM biz_berth_cargo_ship cs WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.company_id IN ) x INNER JOIN biz_berth_cargo c ON c.id = x.cargo_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.direction = 'UNLOAD' GROUP BY x.biz_id

SELECT l.ship_idl.company_id AS bizId, SUM(l.load_tonnage) AS tonnage, SUM(l.load_volume) AS volume, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM biz_ship_load l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.status = 'LOADED' AND l.company_id IN GROUP BY l.ship_idl.company_id

SELECT cs.ship_id AS shipId, c.berth_id AS berthId, b.berth_name AS berthName, c.id AS cargoId, c.cargo_name AS cargoName, 'UNLOAD' AS direction, c.arrive_time AS startTime FROM biz_berth_cargo_ship cs INNER JOIN biz_berth_cargo c ON c.id = cs.cargo_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' INNER JOIN biz_berth b ON b.id = c.berth_id WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.status = 'WORKING' AND cs.company_id IN ORDER BY c.arrive_time DESC

SELECT l.ship_id AS shipId, l.berth_id AS berthId, b.berth_name AS berthName, l.cargo_id AS cargoId, c.cargo_name AS cargoName, l.id AS loadId, 'LOAD' AS direction, l.create_time AS startTime FROM biz_ship_load l INNER JOIN biz_berth_cargo c ON c.id = l.cargo_id INNER JOIN biz_berth b ON b.id = l.berth_id WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.status = 'WAITING' AND l.company_id IN ORDER BY l.create_time DESC
